units.source_text: 千重子折回来，把饵食扔到池子里，

en.t: Chieko turned back and tossed the food into the pond,

units.source_text: 鲤鱼便成群簇拥上来，有的还把身子挺出水面。

en.t: and the carp crowded up in schools, some even thrusting their bodies above the surface of the water.

units.source_text: 微波一圈套一圈地扩展开来。

en.t: Tiny ripples spread outward, ring overlapping ring.

units.source_text: 樱树和松树的倒影也在波面微微摇荡。

en.t: The reflections of the cherry trees and pines also swayed faintly on the rippling surface.
